column1: # of active items^"Demand Planning"^"Select ({DistinctCount(Item.[Item]) as Transient.ItemCount using ~IsNULL(Measure.[Actual])}) on row, () on column where {&CWV}

# of Item * customer * Location^"Demand Planning"^"select (&cwv * {DistinctCount(Item.[Planning Item] * [Sales Domain].[Customer Group] * Location.[Location]) as Transient.RecordCount using ~IsNull(Measure.[Stat Fcst])}) on row, () on column where {&ForecastHorizonCalendar}

# of actuals records^"Demand Planning"^"select ({DistinctCount(Item.[Item] * [Sales Domain].[Ship To] * Location.[Location] * Time.[Week]) as Transient.RecordCount using ~IsNull(Measure.[Actual])}) on row, () on column where {Version.[Version Name].Filter(#.Key == 0)}

# of forecast records^"Demand Planning"^"select ({DistinctCount(Item.[Planning Item] * [Sales Domain].[Customer Group] * Location.[Location] * Time.[Week]) as Transient.RecordCount using ~IsNull(Measure.[Stat Fcst])}) on row, () on column where {Version.[Version Name].Filter(#.Key == 0), Time.[Month].filter(#.Key >=Time.[Month].Filter(#.[Month$IsCurrent]).element(0).leadoffset(24).Key)}
